ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ($User.LastName <> "Integration"), ($User.LastName <> "Pandey"), ($Profile.Name <> "System Administrator"), ($Profile.Name <> "Restricted System Admin"), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type,"Credit Card Application")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type,"Credit Limit Increase Application")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type,"Cash Collateral Credit Limit Increase Application")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type,"Credit Card Supplementary Application")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type,"Credit Card Cash Collateral Application")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type,"Credit Card Prepaid Application")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type,"Credit Card Upgrade")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type,"Credit Card Account Closing")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type,"Convert Credit Card Nature Application")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c,"Generate Cash Collateral Letter")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type,"Relationship Termination")), RecordType.DeveloperName != "Collection_Legal_Action_FCR", RecordType.DeveloperName != "Internal_Case", RecordType.DeveloperName != "Loan_Application", RecordType.DeveloperName != "LoanFinanceServiceRequest", TEXT(Case_Nature__c) != 'FCR', ISCHANGED(Status), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Closed'), ($User.Cannot_Close_Non_Credit_Card_Application__c = true) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot action/ close this case, as it is not owned by your Queue.
